seo.metaTitle: Change Image Aspect Ratio - Crop or Pad, No Upload
seo.metaDescription: Fit a PNG into another aspect ratio: crop the center to fill the frame, or pad it with transparency. 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 and more. Free, no upload.
seo.longDescription: Change PNG aspect ratio fits an image into another frame, and the difference between the two ways matters: crop to fill keeps the new frame edge to edge and loses the overflowing edges, pad to fit keeps the whole picture and fills the rest with transparency. The usual ratios are one click away — 1:1 for avatars and covers, 4:3 and 3:2 for photos, 16:9 and 9:16 for video and stories. Processing happens in your browser, so the file is never uploaded.
facts: Runs entirely in your browser: no upload, no server, no signup.
Crop to fill cuts the center at full resolution; pad to fit keeps every pixel.
Padding is fully transparent — the picture stays clean on any background.
Free with no daily limit, no watermark and no account, also for commercial use.
howTo: Drop the image into the source area, or pick a file from your device.
Choose Crop to fill to keep the frame edge to edge, or Pad to fit to keep every pixel.
Download the result from the Download button.

faq.a: Crop when the new frame is the visible area and edges may go - covers, avatars, video thumbnails. Pad when nothing may be lost - product shots and logos, where a transparent border is safer than a cut-off edge.

faq.q: What does padding add, and what color?
faq.a: Transparent. The extra space is left with a zero alpha channel, so the picture stays clean on any background. If you need a solid color instead, run the canvas size or padding tool afterwards.
No - crop to fill takes the center at full resolution and only discards the edges. The result is as sharp as the source, just smaller.

faq.q: Can I enter a custom ratio?
faq.a: The page offers the common ones. For an unusual frame, resize the image to the size you need first and then crop the excess with the crop tool.
